item.title: Community weighs in on Detroit's I-75 highway cap project
item.description: Detroit is taking another step toward building a highway cap over I-75, a project aimed at tearing down the barrier that separates downtown from the city's northern neighborhoods.

item.title: Community, Wyandotte school board urge trustee to resign over bigoted comment
item.description: The Wyandotte Board of Education passed a resolution denouncing a fellow trustee's bigoted comment on social media comparing Muslims to dogs.

item.title: In Democratic response, Spanberger accuses Trump of lying in State of the Union
item.description: Virginia Gov. Abigail Spanberger delivered the Democratic response to President Donald Trump’s State of the Union address Tuesday night.
